files_to_create.purpose: Define the User model with email and name fields.
Define the Item model with ownerId, title, description, pricePerDay, and isFree fields.
Define the Booking model with itemId, borrowerId, startDate, and endDate fields.
Handle the creation of new items.
Define the routes for item creation and booking requests.
Set up the Express server, connect to MongoDB, and include routes.
